d695d6f1b1:
I can't believe your goal with Laplace's Box is
simply to restore Zeon... Let me hear it, Captain
Full Frontal. What do you truly intend?
ae5f5c5b4d:
Strengthen ties between the Moon and the seven Sides,
and build an economic sphere without Earth: the Side
Co-Prosperity Sphere. Only the Zeon Republic can lead it.
b0fc841743:
The problem is that the Republic's autonomy is soon to be
returned. We'll use the Box to threaten the Federation,
delay the Republic's dissolution, and buy time.
bc504807bd:
...Once heard, it's a dull story. Rather than demand that
those who won't change do so, just ignore them. It's far
from Zeon Deikun's ideal of mankind's evolution.
4fd6a52175:
And far from Char's madness and passion, which sought
to make Earth uninhabitable and send all mankind to space.
...Are you satisfied with that?
ddbf4b65ed:
A vessel does not think.
It only acts on the collective will poured into it.
To keep all of mankind alive.
8e832f539d:
...Somehow it's like it's someone else's problem.
You're talking about your own future, but your words
feel cold, as if it's none of your business.
412c1e52c2:
The Char Aznable I knew really is dead.
Industrial 7... That's the final coordinate the Laplace
Program showed. This is too much for this boy...
14bc0cb104:
Banagher, we'll take our leave now.
From here on, it's a race!
40f663b0cf:
Banagher Links,
Full Armor Unicorn Gundam, launching!
a6583ff74f:
Banagher has mastered his. I'll do the same.
...Where's the Unicorn!?
e725dd6891:
Banagher Links, gone into space with Mineva Zabi, met
up with the Nahel Argama, but came under attack from
Federation ships acting at the Vist Foundation's request.
e5865a46ef:
They were saved by the Sleeves, led by Full Frontal.
Forced to fight alongside them, Mineva
pressed Frontal on his true intentions.
ae58e6f742:
Meanwhile, the Nahel Argama's crew, unhappy with the
joint front with the Sleeves, rose up as one and
expelled the Sleeves who had occupied the ship.
af8fa31e2c:
At last the final battle over Laplace's Box draws near.
The Unicorn Gundam is refitted as the heavily armed
Full Armor Unicorn Gundam.
be0fc7771e:
But as Banagher sorties, Riddhe Marcenas, in league with
Alberto Vist, appears piloting the Banshee to strike
down the Unicorn Gundam.
6cef6a1a69:
What you are trying to do would rather shut off
possibility. It's a mistake to expect too much possibility
from people or the world. People don't change or learn.
53ec69bbc7:
Make way, Full Frontal.
A man who can no longer believe in humanity's
future should keep his mouth shut!
3d56841ced:
Don't you understand, Lady Mineva? I am who you will be
tomorrow. Once you know the truth of people and the world,
you and Banagher will think just as I do.
c11a6fdb3b:
...No! I knew Char!
The Char Aznable who praised my violin playing
was not an empty man like you!
8cf51f37e1:
Those who won't change can have a future to match.
That is what I'll use the Box for. It is mankind's
retribution for rejecting the Newtype.
ffe95d174f:
You do nothing yourself, can't do anything, and only look
down on people and laugh. You're just scum.
A cowardly puppet wearing Char's skin!
daeab3be12:
Breaking through the Sleeves' main force, Banagher and
Audrey reached Industrial 7 and at last learned the truth
of the Box. Frontal pursued them even there.
944fb65ca1:
The fight over the Box went beyond mobile suits
into hand-to-hand combat. Banagher and Mineva
clashed with Frontal over their values.
59b30a5a52:
Frontal went on weaving words full of despair.
Words only Char Aznable could have known,
as if spoken by Char himself, were aimed at the two.
eb8e78cf6d:
With no winner on foot, Banagher and Frontal take
to their mobile suits again. The battered Unicorn
Gundam and the Sinanju collide.
a14f9ac326:
The beast of possibility... the Unicorn Gundam.
Banagher squeezes out its last strength.
The time to settle things with the Red Comet's phantom draws near.
